meta.rule: One-day drop of 10 percent or more on at least 2.5 times the prior 20-day volume in the last 15 sessions, $5B+ names, where next-year EPS estimates have fallen less than 2 percent since the day before the drop.
caveats: Until estimate snapshots cover the drop date, the estimate change uses Yahoo's 7 or 30 day trend fields and is flagged 'estimate history building'.
gap_left_pct = how far the pre-drop close is above today's price.
